output.summary: A perennial woody bamboo native to China and Japan. It spreads widely through underground rhizomes, and mass flowering may be separated by more than a century. Young spring shoots are eaten cooked as a vegetable, but are bitter raw and require boiling in plenty of water with several water changes.
output.edibilityNote: Young spring shoots are eaten cooked; because they are bitter raw, they require boiling in plenty of water with several water changes.
